headlines.description: Arsenal's bid to win the Champions League for the first time in their 140-year history ended in heartbreak after a penalty shootout defeat to Paris Saint-Germain.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG beat Arsenal on penalties to defend Champions League title

headlines.shortLinkText: PSG rally past Monaco after Dembélé forced off

headlines.shortLinkText: Super subs give Arsenal perfect UCL start in Bilbao

headlines.shortLinkText: Kane gives Bayern 1st-leg edge at Real Madrid

headlines.shortLinkText: Havertz rescues Arsenal in 1st-leg win vs. Sporting

headlines.description: Ousmane Dembélé scored two late goals as Paris Saint-Germain extinguished Liverpool's hopes of a comeback to march into the Champions League semifinals 4-0 on aggregate.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dembélé finishes Liverpool to put PSG in semis

headlines.description: Arne Slot's 100th match as Liverpool boss ended in defeat as Galatasaray capitalised on a sloppy display to win the first leg of this Champions League last-16 tie 1-0 on a deafening evening in Istanbul.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gala gain upper hand in 1st leg win over Liverpool

headlines.description: Michael Olise played a starring role as Bayern Munich demolished Atalanta 6-1 to virtually guarantee their place in the Champions League quarterfinals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rampant Bayern net 6 at Atalanta in 1st-leg rout

notes.headline: 2nd Leg - Sporting CP advance 5-3 on aggregate

headlines.description: Sporting CP became the fifth team to overturn a three-goal first-leg deficit to progress in the Champions League knockout rounds with a 5-3 aggregate win over Bodo/Glimt.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sporting score 5 in 2nd leg to end dream Bodo run

headlines.description: Eberechi Eze scored a stunning first Champions League goal as Arsenal beat Bayer Leverkusen 2-0 on Tuesday at the Emirates to march into the quarterfinals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eze stunner seals Arsenal spot in UCL quarters

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain and Bayern Munich produced an epic Champions League semifinal as the French holders claimed a 5-4 first-leg victory at Parc des Princes.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG edge Bayern in semifinal 1st-leg classic

headlines.description: Atlético Madrid and Arsenal will head to north London next week with all to play for after a 1-1 draw in Wednesday's Champions League semifinal first leg.
headlines.shortLinkText: Atlético and Arsenal trade penalties in 1st-leg draw

headlines.description: Bukayo Saka scored the decisive goal to send Arsenal to their first Champions League final in 20 years following a 1-0 win against Atletico Madrid at the Emirates Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bukayo Saka fires Arsenal to first Champions League final in 20 years

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain will play Arsenal in the Champions League final after they drew 1-1 with Bayern Munich in the Allianz Arena to seal a 6-5 aggregate semifinal victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG hold off Bayern Munich to return to UCL final
